faq.q: Does the $800K cap cover the typical Abbotsford condo?
faq.a: The cap sits above the middle of the combined attached market: the Abbotsford Condos & Townhomes median sale price was $497,500 in September 2026 — $302,500 below the cap — though that median mixes townhomes with condos, so treat it as context for where the cap sits, not as the price of a typical condo (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Where does Abbotsford's attached stock actually sit?
faq.a: By September 2026 inventory, Central Abbotsford held 256 Condos & Townhomes listings and Abbotsford West 210, out of 572 Abbotsford-wide, and the rural sub-areas (Bradner, Matsqui, Sumas Mountain, Sumas Prairie) held none — those are combined condo-and-townhome inventory counts, not counts of condos under the cap (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Can a first-time buyer use the PTT exemption under $800K in Abbotsford?
faq.a: In principle, yes — the first time home buyers' program's full exemption runs to a fair market value of $835,000 (exempting the first $500,000 of price), with a partial exemption to $860,000, provided the buyer meets all the program's personal and property conditions; the exemption is claimed through the buyer's legal professional on the PTT return.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Central Abbotsford condo address?
faq.a: Catchments are address-based in SD34 and are set by the district's School Locator. In the locator runs recorded for this program, 33130 Bevan Ave returns Godson Elementary → Abbotsford Middle → Abbotsford Senior Secondary, and 32161 Dormick Avenue returns Dormick Park Elementary → Abbotsford Middle → Abbotsford Senior Secondary; run the building's exact address before relying on a school assignment (SD34 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01).
